title: Magic File Renamer — Batch rename and tag files on Windows
excerpt: Magic File Renamer — batch rename and tag files on Windows. Filter Chain, live preview, audio tags, EXIF, presets, and console automation.
content_html:
Magic File Renamer is a Windows batch renamer and audio tagger: build a Filter Chain, preview names and tags live, then apply. It covers casing, replace, Formatter tokens, audio tags, image/EXIF, Path Mover, presets, and console automation. Download MFR 8 for Windows 10 or later (64-bit).

Latest version: Magic File Renamer 8.0.2-beta

Highlights

  • The most comprehensive and flexible file-renaming and audio tagging software for Windows.
  • Extensive Filter Chain with case, space, trimming, replace, formatting, audio, attributes, and misc filters for almost any renaming task.
  • Audio tag read/write for MP3 (ID3v1/ID3v2), Ogg/Opus, FLAC, APE, M4A/MP4 (Apple), WMA/ASF, and WAV (RIFF INFO).
  • Pattern renaming with Formatter tokens from audio tags, media properties, image/EXIF, and document Info (PDF, EPUB, Office).
  • Read image properties and EXIF from JPEG, TIFF, PNG, GIF, HEIF/HEIC, and related formats.
  • Reverse geocoding via GeoNames — nearby country, region, and place from GPS in image EXIF.
  • Path Mover relocates files and can build folder hierarchies from patterns in the same operation.
  • Real-time preview (including before/after), Rename Log, and Undo Last for any changes made.
  • Presets and console mode (mfrc) for automatic batch renaming from the command line.
